description: A coloring book page with a sea turtle in a circular scene lies on the bed, with an open 64-pack Crayola crayon box behind it. The left hand rests on and steadies the page as a left-hand object, while the right hand, holding a blue crayon as a right-hand object, makes short back-and-forth strokes along the right edge of the circle to fill in the water, then lifts slightly and shifts upward to continue coloring near the top-right.
